name: Canvas Hearts: A Brush With Love
source:
welcome to the first installment in the Canvas Hearts series! starring Zeke, a goth boy who's life is going to be suddenly brightened with his joining of the art club! there he meets two lovely new friends, both of which are pretty uh, pretty cute in his opinion! can you paint the path into their hearts?

[from [url=https://candelabella.itch.io/canvas-hearts-a-brush-with-love]itch.io[/url]]
